title: Open Logix release channel assignments
description: Assigns a component's releases to channels, for one config version: remote-config/<product>/<NNN>/assign.jsonc (Remote updates, in the website repo's CLAUDE.md). A release reads <channel>-channel.jsonc in the same folder (prod-channel.jsonc when there's none for its channel). A release on no list is on dev, the default, so dev is never listed. prod is what users get; its releases must be stable. Release tags only, no ranges; each release on at most one channel. The file is JSONC: comments say why each release was added.

^(?!dev$)[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.description: A channel, such as prod, and its releases.

items.description: A release tag of this component, yyyy-mm-dd.
